entities.summary: Keri is a 3.1-hectare (7.7-acre) Estonian island in the Gulf of Finland. It is located about 6 km north of the island Prangli, and is one of the northernmost islands of Estonia. The uninhabited island is the site of notable Keri lighthouse.
